Consider the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\frac{5 x^{2} - x y + y^{2}}{x^{2} + y^{2}} + \frac{y}{x}.
$$

If the transformation $y=v(x)x$ is applied to the differential equation, what is the resulting equation?
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the transformation $y=vx$ (where $v=v(x)$), we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x) \\  & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the above into the given differential equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{5 x^{2} - x y + y^{2}}{x^{2} + y^{2}} + \frac{y}{x} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =v + \frac{v^{2} x^{2} - v x^{2} + 5 x^{2}}{v^{2} x^{2} + x^{2}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =v + \frac{v^{2} - v + 5}{v^{2} + 1} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{v^{2} - v + 5}{v^{2} + 1} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{v^{2} - v + 5}{v^{2} + 1} \\ \left(\frac{v^{2} + 1}{v^{2} - v + 5}\right)\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{x}.\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=- \frac{y}{x} + \frac{5 x^{2} + y^{2}}{x y}.
$$

If the transformation $y=v(x)x$ is applied to the differential equation, what is the resulting equation?
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the transformation $y=vx$ (where $v=v(x)$), we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x) \\  & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the above into the given differential equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =- \frac{y}{x} + \frac{5 x^{2} + y^{2}}{x y} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =- v + \frac{v^{2} x^{2} + 5 x^{2}}{v x^{2}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =- v + \frac{v^{2} + 5}{v} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =- 2 v + \frac{v^{2} + 5}{v} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{5 - v^{2}}{v} \\ \left(- \frac{v}{v^{2} - 5}\right)\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{x}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\frac{3{y}^{3}}{x{y}^{2}+y{x}^{2}}.
$$

If the transformation $y=v(x)x$ is applied to the differential equation, what is the resulting equation?
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the transformation $y=vx$ (where $v=v(x)$), we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x) \\  & =x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the above into the given differential equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{3{y}^{3}}{x{y}^{2}+y{x}^{2}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =\frac{3(vx)^{3}}{x(vx)^{2}+(vx){x}^{2}} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =\frac{3{v}^{3}{x}^{3}}{v{x}^{3}(v+1)} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}+v & =\frac{3{v}^{3}\cancel{{x}^{3}}}{v\cancel{{x}^{3}}(v+1)} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{3{v}^{2}}{v+1}-v \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{3{v}^{2}}{v+1}-\frac{v(v+1)}{v+1} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{3{v}^{2}-{v}^{2}-v}{v+1} \\ x\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{2{v}^{2}-v}{v+1} \\ \left(\frac{v+1}{2{v}^{2}-v}\right)\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{1}{x}.\end{aligned}
$$
